A holiday movement experience

Make movement part of the celebration.

The December Dash turns a simple 5K goal into a seasonal experience: choose your route, bring your people, complete your miles, and celebrate the finish with WRTS.

❄

Built for December

No complicated training cycle. Just an approachable distance and a reason to keep moving when routines get crowded.

↗

Flexible by design

Neighborhood streets, treadmill, park loop, travel route, or group meet-up—your Dash can happen where life already is.

★

Designed to feel special

A festive medal design and a reason to celebrate every step you take.

◎

Powered by the WRTS community

It is movement with meaning: show up, share the moment, and end the year with momentum.

“One mile at a time.”

No pressure to chase a perfect pace. The December Dash is about choosing movement, making the season memorable, and getting across your own finish line.

The finisher piece

A medal made for the tree—and the medal rack.

The December Dash finisher medal is shaped like a decorated Christmas tree with a full holiday neck ribbon and an engraved-style back built around the message “Happy Holidays — One Mile at a Time.”

December Dash 2026 medal and ribbon concept artwork.

✓

Tree-shaped statement design

Rich holiday color, dimensional ornament details, and a gold-edged silhouette designed to stand out.

✓

Run & Be Merry ribbon

Carry the holiday spirit with the matching forest green, red, and gold ribbon.

✓

A message on both sides

The front celebrates the finish; the back keeps the message focused on movement and holiday joy.

✓

Designed as a keepsake

A seasonal piece you can display with your race medals—or bring back out with the holiday decorations.

Simple on purpose

Three moves. One merry finish.

The December Dash is easy to understand and easy to join—because the best holiday traditions are the ones people actually want to repeat.
